description: Real-world test cases for DeadLinkAnalyzer validation
note: This dataset contains known dead links with expected outcomes for validation. The system should be tested against these cases to measure accuracy.

test_cases.reason: Example URL - not a real dead link, used for testing pipeline
Test endpoint that always returns 404 - no valid replacement exists
Test endpoint with valid redirect to same resource

real_world_examples.reason: Archive URL should never be used as replacement
Real-world case - outcome depends on actual redirect behavior

success_metrics.dead_link_detection_rate: Percentage of dead links correctly identified
success_metrics.candidate_discovery_rate: Percentage of dead links with valid candidates found
success_metrics.repair_accuracy_rate: Percentage of repairs that are actually correct
success_metrics.false_positive_rate: Percentage of incorrect repairs (must be near 0)
success_metrics.false_negative_rate: Percentage of missed repairs (acceptable to be high)

instructions.usage: Run the DeadLinkAnalyzer against these test cases and compare actual outcomes with expected outcomes.
instructions.measurement: Calculate the success metrics defined in validation_criteria.
instructions.acceptance: The system is ready for production only if all thresholds are met.
instructions.important: For Wikipedia production, the false positive rate must be practically zero. It is better to miss 90% of repairs than to publish a single incorrect URL.
